## Validation

Request bodies are validated with [Zod](https://zod.dev). See `src/common/dto/example.dto.ts` for the pattern, and `src/common/pipes/zod-validation.pipe.ts` for the `ZodValidationPipe`, applied per-route with `@UsePipes(new ZodValidationPipe(schema))`.
